//: Marks everything under supabase/functions as a Deno project.
These files run on Deno inside Supabase, not on Node and not in a browser.
The project's tsconfig only covers src/, so `npm run typecheck` already
ignores them — but an editor opening one falls back to the browser settings,
finds no Deno global, and underlines every line that touches it.
With the Deno extension installed this file makes it take over here and
nowhere else, so the React app keeps its own tooling. Without it, deno.d.ts
beside this file declares the handful of Deno APIs these functions use.
